signin.title: Sign in to NuraAI
signin.noProvider: No Ethereum wallet was found in this browser. Install a wallet extension and try again.
signin.checkWallet: The wallet is asking you to read and approve a message.
signin.readCarefully: Before approving, check that the domain is {{domain}}. A signature here never sends a transaction and never costs gas.
signin.smartWalletNotice: Smart-contract wallets verify through a chain call and can take longer. On timeout the sign-in is refused; retrying will not change the outcome.
signin.expired: The sign-in challenge expired. Start again to get a new one.
signin.domainMismatch: The sign-in message does not match this site. Stop and contact support if you did not start this.
signin.signatureFailed: The signature could not be verified.
signin.lostWallet: A lost wallet is a lost account. There is no reset path, so back up the recovery phrase before continuing.
signin.statement: Sign in to NuraAI. This request will not trigger a transaction or cost any gas.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Activity, spend, and security signals for {{team}}.
overview.signalsGood: No denied calls in this period
overview.signalsGoodHelp: Denials are the access controls working as designed, so an empty list is good news.

knowledge.teamRecord: Active team · stored name and identifier
knowledge.limits: This slice supports bases, item inventory, plain-text ingestion and individual trust review. Uploads, Files/S3, editing, deletion and search are not available. Metadata editing is deferred.
knowledge.deniedWrite: Creating, ingesting or changing trust requires knowledge.write.
knowledge.emptyBases: No knowledge bases yet. Create a base when you have write access.
knowledge.emptyItems: No items yet. Ingest plain text when you have write access.
knowledge.name: Base name
knowledge.title: Title (optional)
knowledge.provenanceHelp: The source is user-supplied text, not a verified origin. Missing provenance is unknown, not evidence of safety.
knowledge.trustHelp: Review the complete content, metadata and provenance before deciding. Trust changes require successfully loaded matching details and both knowledge.read and knowledge.write. The server also requires a human user.
knowledge.unknownTrust: This trust level is not recognized. Trust changes are blocked; reload or contact support.
knowledge.trustConsequence: Agents may act on this item without the approval step caused by untrusted knowledge. Other permissions and approval rules still apply. This records your user identity and time for this item only; it does not verify the source or trust the whole base.
knowledge.revokeConsequence: This item becomes untrusted. Future retrieval can make a run untrusted, requiring approval for write-tier actions. Current trust attribution is cleared. This does not undo past actions or revoke agent access to the item.
knowledge.ingestionHelp: New items are untrusted. Content is stored without trimming. Title and source are optional; no files are uploaded.
knowledge.fieldInvalid: Check this value. Required fields must not be empty; maximum {{limit}} characters.

errors.load: Authoritative records could not be loaded. Trust changes are blocked. Reload to review current records.

agents.activeTeam: Active team · stored name and identifier
agents.noRequestId: Not available; no request identifier was received.
agents.needsPermission: Access denied. This section requires {{permission}}. Ask a team administrator for access.
agents.name: Name
agents.modelHelp: Only active models are offered. An unavailable stored model is preserved unless you explicitly choose another model or no model.
agents.noModels: No active models are available. You can save without a model and configure one later.
agents.unavailablePreserved: Unavailable in this catalog. The stored identifier is preserved unless you explicitly remove or replace it.
agents.modelCatalog: Model catalog · name, provider and identifier
agents.budgetHelp: Each limit must be a positive whole number, at most 9,007,199,254,740,991. These are runtime limits, not spending targets.
agents.settingsPreserved: Advanced settings are not edited here. Stored settings and unrelated budget keys are preserved.
agents.panelSaves: Each panel replaces only its own grant set. Save panels separately; there is no combined save. Unavailable catalogs block that panel's save.
agents.removalHelp: These saved grants or capabilities will be removed. Other changes in this panel will also be saved; other panels will not change.
agents.workflowWarning: Removing access or a destination can break workflows that use it. Workflow destination usage is not available here; check affected workflows before continuing.
agents.removedValues: Current configuration · identifiers and destinations being removed
agents.writeWarning: Write-tier permissions on agents exposed to external messages require human approval for each write action. This is intended. Admin-tier and user-only permissions are not offered.
agents.knowledgeWarning: This agent has source grants. If a source is public, anything in these knowledge bases can be revealed to whoever messages it. Public exposure cannot be determined from this catalog; review source access before granting knowledge.
agents.knowledgeHelp: Knowledge can be disclosed to anyone who can message the agent. Review this panel again before connecting a public source.
agents.emptyCatalog: No resources are available in this catalog.
agents.noGrants: No grants selected in this panel.
agents.grantLimit: Select at most 200 resources per panel.
agents.sourcesHelp: Grant individual source connections, then choose where this agent can message. New grants allow replies only by default.
agents.noConnections: No source connections are available. Connect a source before granting it.
agents.sourceConnection: Source catalog · source, type, connection, ownership, status and identifier
agents.canReply: Reply on the conversation a request arrives on
agents.exactDestinations: Enter each exact destination explicitly. No imports, patterns or wildcards. Turning off sending preserves the allowlist but disables its use and editing.
agents.destinationHelp: Add one exact identifier or address, up to 500 characters. Add it to the list before saving the panel.
agents.draftRemoval: This removes the destination from the draft. Save the sources panel to apply the change.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Create an agent to configure its model, budgets and grants.
agents.agentRecord: Agent record · stored name and identifier
agents.effectiveBudgets: Effective limits shown, including runtime defaults for absent values.
agents.runsDeferred: Run history and run execution are not included in this screen yet.
agents.deleteHelp: Deletion is permanent and removes the agent's grants. Agents with run history cannot be deleted; archive them instead.
agents.statusHelp: This prevents new runs. Existing run history and grants are preserved. You can activate the agent again later.

errors.inUse: This agent has run history and cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.unknownResource: A selected resource is no longer available. Reload its catalog and review the stored selection before saving again.
errors.allowlist: Sending to other destinations requires at least one exact allowed destination. Add a destination or turn off sending.
errors.invalid: Some values were rejected. Review the fields and limits before trying again.
errors.notFound: This agent or resource no longer exists. Return to the list and refresh.
errors.denied: Access denied by the team's permissions. Ask a team administrator for access; existing selections have not been cleared.
errors.expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.failed: The request could not be completed. Reload and review the saved state before retrying; a change may have reached the server.
errors.network: The service could not be reached. Check your connection, then reload the saved state before retrying.
errors.name: Enter a name containing 1–200 characters, not only spaces.
errors.budget: Enter a positive whole number within the supported limit.
errors.sources: Review source grants: at most 100 connections, at most 200 unique exact destinations each, and a non-empty allowlist when sending is enabled.
errors.destination: Enter a unique exact destination of 1–500 characters without whitespace, wildcards, pattern syntax or invisible controls. At most 200 destinations are allowed.

approvals.denied: Access denied. Approval review requires approval.decide. Ask a team administrator for access.
approvals.invalidExpiry: Expiry is invalid or unavailable. Decisions are disabled; refresh to check the server record.
approvals.elapsed: Deadline elapsed on this device. Stored status is still pending; decisions are disabled. The server determines expiry.
approvals.copyFailed: Copy unavailable. Select the reference text and copy it manually.
approvals.noLongerAvailable: This request is no longer in the returned records. Return to the queue or refresh.
approvals.agentIdentity: Approval record · agent name and identifier
approvals.available: {{number}} matching returned records. Not a total count or daily rate. Repeated causes may need narrower agent grants, not faster decisions.
approvals.localFilters: Filters apply to available records in this view; URL filter sharing is deferred until root routing is available.
approvals.empty: No approval requests match these filters in the available records.
approvals.nearestExpiry: Nearest expiry first within each cause
approvals.actionRecord: Suspended action · tool, tier and exact arguments
approvals.requestedUnverified: Requested destination — unverified. The stored field is not an allowlist validation. The server checks the destination and current grants when executing.
approvals.reasonCode: Tool call record · policy reason code
approvals.trigger: What was recorded with this request
approvals.sourceLimitation: This is the last user message and recorded ingress metadata, not necessarily the content that lowered trust. The actual trust-lowering source and its receipt time are not provided.
approvals.triggerRecord: Approval record · recorded origin and last user message (carried content)
approvals.exactAction: Approve exactly this action, these arguments and this requested destination only. Run trust stays unchanged. This grants no permissions and does not approve later actions. The server remains the authority on permission and expiry.
approvals.unsafeContext: Action context is incomplete or invalid. Approval is disabled. Refresh or reject the pending request; no missing context is inferred.
approvals.approved: Approved. Approval is not a claim that the run succeeded; review the returned run outcome.
approvals.waitingAgain: The run is waiting for another approval. The queue has been refreshed; review the next action separately.
approvals.deciding: Decision in progress; waiting for the server and an authoritative refresh…
approvals.reasonHelp: Up to 2,000 characters. The reason is sent to the model as a structured refusal.
approvals.reasonTooLong: Use at most 2,000 characters for the rejection reason.

reasons.untrustedWrite: Write actions in untrusted run context require a person's approval.
reasons.missingGrant: The agent does not hold the required grant.
reasons.admin: Administration actions cannot be executed in an agent run.
reasons.read: The recorded policy allows a read-only action at this trust level.
reasons.reply: The recorded policy allows a reply at this trust level.
reasons.write: The recorded policy allows writing at this trust level.
reasons.userGrant: The requesting user holds the required write grant.
reasons.userDenied: The requesting user lacks the required write grant.
reasons.unknown: The policy cause is unavailable or not recognized. Review the recorded action and context; do not infer a cause.

errors.localExpiry: The deadline elapsed on this device while waiting. No decision was sent. Refresh the server record.
errors.expired: The server reports that this approval expired. Refresh the queue; it cannot be decided.
errors.decided: This approval was already decided, possibly by another reviewer. Refresh the record.
errors.notWaiting: The run is no longer waiting for this approval. Refresh the queue.
errors.unavailable: The agent or model is unavailable. Review its configuration and refresh before deciding again.
errors.context: The suspended action context cannot be resumed. Refresh and investigate using the references.
errors.revoked: The action's grant was revoked. Approval cannot restore it. Refresh and review the agent's grants.
errors.invalid: The decision was not accepted. Check the rejection reason limit and refresh the record.
errors.denied: Access denied by current team permissions. Ask a team administrator for approval.decide access.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.notFound: This approval or its run is no longer available. Refresh the queue.
errors.outcomeUnknown: Decision outcome unknown. It may have reached the server. No automatic retry was sent; an authoritative refresh was requested. Review the refreshed record before any further decision.
errors.decisionFailed: The decision could not be completed. Refresh and inspect the stored state before deciding again.
errors.load: Approvals or effective permissions could not be loaded. Counts are unknown. Check your connection and refresh.

sources.teamOnly: New connection records are team-owned only. Creating user-owned records is deferred; existing user-owned records remain visible. The API does not return the owning user's identifier.
sources.connectionStatusHelp: Connection status below is the stored registry value, not a live health check or proof of authentication.
sources.connectionCreated: Connection record created; credentials were not provisioned.
sources.noRequestId: Not available; no request identifier was received.
sources.denied: Access denied. This action requires {{permission}}. Ask a team administrator for access.
sources.empty: No source records yet. With source.connect access, create a source by entering its type and name.
sources.sourceRecord: Source record · stored name, type and identifier
sources.webhookPresent: Reference present; delivery and verification have not been tested here.
sources.removeHelp: This permanently removes only the selected connection record. Revoke any agent grant to this connection before removal. Other connections and source configuration are unchanged. This does not revoke credentials at an external provider.
sources.connectionRecord: Connection record · stored name and identifier
sources.storedConnectionStatus: Connection record · stored status (not verified health)
sources.noConnections: No connection records for this source. With source.connect access, add a team-owned record below the source details.
sources.name: Name
sources.statusHelp: Active allows the team to use this source definition; disabled marks it unavailable. Neither value describes connection health. Saving does not remove connections or change configuration.
